semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For every integer n with n > 1, define F_n on real x by F_n(x) = floor(n times x) minus the sum over integers k from 1 to n of floor(k times x) divided by k. result_payload.proof_nl:
Fix an integer n > 1 and an integer m with 0 <= m <= n-1. By the definition of F_n, for any real x,

F_n(x) = floor(n x) - sum_{k=1}^n floor(k x)/k.

Substitute x = m/n. Then

F_n(m/n) = floor(n(m/n)) - sum_{k=1}^n floor(k(m/n))/k.

Since n(m/n) = m and m is an integer, floor(n(m/n)) = floor(m) = m. Therefore

F_n(m/n) = m - sum_{k=1}^n floor(k m/n)/k,

which is exactly the desired identity.
result_payload.proof_summary: Direct substitution of x = m/n into the definition of F_n, together with floor(m) = m for integer m.

used_external_facts: floor of an integer equals the integer itself
